plain.li: I dreamt I was cooking for the whole colony on one small pot, and I worked out how to get the timing right for everything.
I dreamt someone stood next to me at the stove and showed me how much salt to use, and I think I remember it.
[lowtech] I dreamt I was cooking over an open fire and finally got the heat even all the way through.
[!lowtech] I dreamt I was in a big kitchen with every burner going, and I kept up with all of it.

warm.li: I dreamt I cooked a supper that everyone here liked, and I want to try it for real tonight.

blunt.li: I dreamt about cooking and learned something I'll use tonight.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I made the best stew anyone has ever eaten, and I think I know how I did it.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I burned everything, and then I did it again properly. At least I know where I went wrong.

cold.li: I went over my cooking in my sleep and found two things I've been doing wrong.

plain.li: I dreamt I was closing a wound, and my hands knew exactly what to do at every step.
I dreamt I was operating on someone and everything went right, and I woke up remembering how.
[lowtech] I dreamt I set a broken leg so cleanly that it healed perfectly straight.
[!lowtech] I dreamt I was in a clean operating room with good light, and I didn't make a single mistake.

warm.li: I dreamt I saved someone I couldn't save before, and I want to be ready if it comes to that again.

blunt.li: I dreamt about surgery, and my hands are steady today if anyone needs me.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I did the most difficult operation of my life and it worked perfectly.

gloomy.li: I dreamt about the patient I lost, and this time I saw what I should have done.

cold.li: I rehearsed a difficult operation in my sleep. I'm confident I could do it now.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of being followed home

plain.li: I dreamt a wild animal followed me home from the woods and walked into the pen by itself.
I dreamt I sat still in the grass until the animals came and ate out of my hand.
[lowtech] I dreamt I walked out with a handful of grain and came back with a whole herd behind me.
[!lowtech] I dreamt I was working with an animal nobody else could get near, and it let me put a halter on it.

warm.li: I dreamt a wild animal came up and leaned against me, and I want to go out and find one like it.

blunt.li: I dreamt I tamed something wild, and today I'm going to do it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt every animal on the land wanted to live here with us.

gloomy.li: I dreamt the animals ran from everyone but me. I should make use of that while it lasts.

cold.li: I dreamt about how to approach a wild animal without startling it. I'll try it this afternoon.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a good bargain

plain.li: I dreamt I traded a sack of turnips for a cartload of good things, and the trader thanked me for it.
I dreamt I was haggling at a market and knew exactly when to stop and when to keep going.
[lowtech] I dreamt I traded at a big gathering of the peoples and came home with more than I took.
[!lowtech] I dreamt the next trader to come by gave us a price they would never normally give.

warm.li: I dreamt a trader and I ended up laughing together and both got a fair deal.

blunt.li: I dreamt about a good bargain, so send me to the next trader.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I talked a trader into giving us everything on the cart for half the price.

gloomy.li: I dreamt the trader tried to cheat me and I saw through it. I'll be watching for that.

cold.li: I dreamt through a negotiation, step by step. I know what to ask for next time.

plain.li: I dreamt I was sparring with someone faster than me, and by the end I was keeping up.
I dreamt I fought the same bout over and over until I stopped dropping my guard.
[lowtech] I dreamt I was practising with a spear in the yard and finally got the footwork right.
[!lowtech] I dreamt I was in a close fight in a corridor and kept my balance the whole time.

warm.li: I dreamt I was teaching one of the young ones to fight, and I learned more than they did.

blunt.li: I fought all night in my sleep and won the last one, and I feel sharper for it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I beat everyone in the colony at wrestling, one after the other.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I lost a fight I should have won, and then I saw why.

cold.li: I went through a fight move by move in my sleep and found the opening I keep missing.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of talking someone round

plain.li: I dreamt I sat with a prisoner all night and by morning they wanted to stay with us.
I dreamt I found the right thing to say to someone who wouldn't listen to anyone.
[lowtech] I dreamt I shared a meal with a captive by the fire, and they told me about their people.
[!lowtech] I dreamt the cell door was open and the prisoner didn't leave, because we were still talking.

warm.li: I dreamt a prisoner told me they'd never been treated so well, and asked if they could join us.

blunt.li: I dreamt I won a prisoner over, and I'm going to try it today.

cheerful.li: I dreamt every prisoner we've ever had ended up joining us, and they were all good at something.

gloomy.li: I dreamt a prisoner finally trusted me. I'd like that to be true for once.

cold.li: I dreamt about what a prisoner actually wants to hear. I have a better approach now.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the work done

plain.li: I dreamt every job on the list was done by noon, and I want to see how close I can get today.
I dreamt I worked all day without getting tired, and I woke up wanting to start right away.
[lowtech] I dreamt the woodpile was stacked, the fields were weeded and the hides were scraped, all before dark.
[!lowtech] I dreamt the work orders were all finished and the benches were clean.

warm.li: I dreamt I did everyone's chores so they could have the afternoon off, and I'd like to try.

blunt.li: I dreamt about work and woke up ready for it.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I built a whole house before breakfast, so today I'm going to do as much as I can.

gloomy.li: I dreamt the work never ended, so I'd better get a head start on it.

cold.li: I planned the whole day in my sleep. I'm going to work through it without stopping.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the deep rock

plain.li: I dreamt I could see through the rock to where the seam runs, and I remember which way it goes.
I dreamt I was digging and the rock came away cleanly at every stroke because I'd found the grain of it.
[lowtech] I dreamt I was working with an antler pick and learned to split the stone along its cracks.
[!lowtech] I dreamt I drilled through a whole hillside without the drill catching once.

warm.li: I dreamt I dug us a big warm room under the hill, and everyone moved in.

blunt.li: I dreamt about the rock and I know where to dig now.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the mountain was full of silver and I found every vein.

gloomy.li: I dreamt the tunnel came down around me, and then I saw what I should have propped first.

cold.li: I went over the rock face in my sleep. I know how to take it down faster now.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a fire in my room

plain.li: I dreamt I had a little fire in my own room, and I fell asleep warm for once, and then I woke up cold.
I dreamt I was lying by a hearth in my room listening to the wood crack, and now my room feels very cold.
[lowtech] I dreamt I had a fire pit by my bed with embers that lasted all night.
[!lowtech] I dreamt my room had its own heater and I could feel my feet in the morning.

warm.li: I dreamt I had a fire in my room and my friends came in to sit by it with me.

blunt.li: I dreamt I was warm, and I'm not, so I want a fire in my room.

cheerful.li: I dreamt my room had the best fire in the colony, and I'd love that to be true.

gloomy.li: I dreamt I was warm, which only made waking up in the cold worse.

cold.li: I dreamt about a heat source in my room. I'd sleep better with one, and I'll ask for it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the gap in the wall

plain.li: I dreamt the attackers found a gap in our defences that nobody had noticed, and walked straight in.
I dreamt we were all inside when they came, and there was nothing between them and the door.
[lowtech] I dreamt the palisade was too low and they climbed over it while we were still running for our spears.
[!lowtech] I dreamt our walls had no cover behind them and we had nowhere to shoot from.

warm.li: I dreamt they got in and I couldn't get to the others in time. We need better walls.

blunt.li: I dreamt they got through, so fix the defences.

cheerful.li: I had a nightmare about the walls, so let's make them better and I'll stop having it.

gloomy.li: I dreamt they got in, and I don't think we could stop them if they came now.

cold.li: I dreamt about the last attack and saw where our defences are weakest. We should fix that.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the open gate

plain.li: I dreamt animals came in from the road by themselves and stood by our pens as if they'd always lived here.
I dreamt the gate was open and a few tame animals walked in, looking for someone to feed them.
[lowtech] I dreamt a few beasts with no herder came down the valley and stopped at our fence.

warm.li: I dreamt some lost animals found their way to us, and we gave them a home.

cheerful.li: I dreamt animals just walked in and joined us, and there were enough for everyone to have one.

cold.li: I dreamt of stray animals arriving at the colony. If they come, we should have the pens ready.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the passing herd

plain.li: I dreamt a long line of animals crossed our land from one side to the other, and the ground shook as they passed.
I dreamt I stood on a hill and watched a whole herd go by below, and it took all day.
[lowtech] I dreamt the herd came through the valley, and the hunters were waiting for it.

warm.li: I dreamt a herd passed close to the colony and the children ran out to watch.

cheerful.li: I dreamt of more animals than I could count walking past the walls, and there was meat for everyone that winter.

cold.li: I dreamt a herd crossed the land. If it does, the hunters should be ready.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the dry storm

plain.li: I dreamt of lightning with no rain, striking the dry grass again and again, and small fires starting everywhere.
I dreamt a storm came over without a drop of water in it, and I could smell smoke when I woke.
[lowtech] I dreamt lightning hit the grass by the fields and we beat out the flames with wet hides.

warm.li: I dreamt of a dry storm and fires in the grass, and everyone running to put them out together.

gloomy.li: I dreamt of lightning starting fires all over the land, and we couldn't keep up with them.

cold.li: I dreamt of a dry lightning storm. I'd clear the brush away from the walls, just in case.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the lights in the sky

plain.li: I dreamt the night sky was full of green and purple light moving like curtains, and everyone stayed up to watch.
I dreamt the sky lit up at night with colours I didn't have names for.
[child] I dreamt the sky was glowing green and I was allowed to stay up late to see it.

warm.li: I dreamt we all lay in the grass at night and watched lights move across the sky together.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the whole sky was dancing with colours, and it was the most beautiful thing I've seen.

cold.li: I dreamt of an aurora over the colony. If one comes, it would be worth staying up for.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: the dream of the one from the woods

plain.li: I dreamt someone came out of the trees who had lived alone so long that they had forgotten how to talk.
I dreamt a person in rags was watching the colony from the edge of the woods, and wouldn't come any closer.
[lowtech] I dreamt of someone living wild like an animal, sleeping in the bushes at the edge of our land.

warm.li: I dreamt someone wild and alone came to the edge of our fields, and I wanted to bring them in and feed them.

gloomy.li: I dreamt someone was out there living like an animal, and nobody had ever come for them.

cold.li: I dreamt a feral person came near the colony. If one does, they could be tamed like an animal, and perhaps taught to work.
